name: Qalaba'r Festival Grounds
title: 74.2S, 21.9E - Qalaba'r Festival Grounds
summary: One of the Festival Grounds, a short run east of Qalaba'r (acpedia: two shopkeepers in tents, two chessboards, target drudges, a fountain). In the kit: two avenues of dark wooden archways (x 29718 and 29733-29738, 3.9 m) lined with blue glass lamps, two octagon towers with red flags, two chessboard platforms, benches, stone monuments, a fountain and straw/wood/oak target drudges on flat grass at z 108, below the Wintersebb knoll.

landmarks.name: Arch avenues (0x0200004F)
landmarks.note: 18 wooden archways in two rows with 17 blue lamps.

landmarks.name: Octagon towers with flags
landmarks.note: Two 0x01000F06 towers (top 112.5) with red flags to 116.

landmarks.name: Chessboard platforms
landmarks.note: 0x01002C0C platforms with Chess Board spawns at (29724,6660) and (29748,6588).

site.name: Qalaba'r Festival Grounds
site.notes: Derived @teleloc on the open ground 44 m east of the arch avenues (ground + 0.5, nothing within 10 m); the gazetteer fountain-near-qalabar teleport lands on the fountain spawn.

shots.standingOrder: Jib up 12 m and swing 18 degrees from 70 m east of the grounds over the arch avenues and chessboard platforms to the Wintersebb knoll beyond; keep 15 m from every tent, flag and arch, wandering drudges may be faded.
shots.notes: Jib from the east edge of the grounds: a slow 12 m rise with an 18 degree swing lifts over the arch avenues, chessboard platforms and flags to show the Wintersebb knoll and its stone 90 m beyond; morning sun from behind the camera. shots.standingOrder: Fly west 24 m above the Festival Grounds straight over the two avenues of wooden arches, blue lamps and flags, gimbal tracking them through vertical toward the Wintersebb knoll; stay 12 m above every flag pole, target drudges may be faded.
shots.notes: Overhead crossing of the Qalaba'r Festival Grounds: two avenues of dark wooden archways with blue glass lamps, red flags on the octagon towers and the chessboard platforms pass beneath, the gimbal tracking the avenue centre through vertical (yaw-slew 45 deg/s) and ending on the Wintersebb knoll; the low morning sun is behind the lens at the start, so arches and flags cast long west-pointing shadows across the grass.
